title: Conductor paired microbenchmark v1
cost_basis: standard API list-price equivalent; not measured subscription billing
limitations: 20 synthetic single-file microtasks; not full StruxOs tasks
one observation per arm per task; no statistical superiority claim
same model alias requested; provider snapshot not independently pinned
host execution; held-out tests separated by layout and instructions, not a security boundary
wall time includes variable host and provider load

tasks.title: Tenant-scoped inventory
tasks.contract: available(rows, tenant, sku) sums quantity minus reserved for matching tenant AND sku. Ignore other rows; empty result is zero. Do not mutate rows.

tasks.title: Revision-specific approval
tasks.contract: can_release(revision, approvals, shortage) is true only if shortage is zero and at least one approved record has exactly the requested revision. Rejected or old approvals never qualify.

tasks.title: Exact stock arithmetic
tasks.contract: remaining(stock, issued) accepts decimal strings and returns a fixed two-decimal string using decimal arithmetic and ROUND_HALF_UP. Raise ValueError for negative inputs or issued greater than stock.

tasks.title: QR identity round trip
tasks.contract: encode(parts) and decode(text) round-trip a list of arbitrary strings, including delimiters, Unicode, empty strings and leading zeros. Encoded form must be compact JSON (ensure_ascii=False, separators comma/colon). decode accepts only a JSON list of strings, otherwise ValueError.

tasks.title: Latest event per entity
tasks.contract: latest(events) returns one event per (tenant,id), highest integer version wins; a tie keeps the first occurrence. Preserve order of each key's first appearance and return copies so editing results cannot alter inputs.

tasks.title: Independent package copies
tasks.contract: clone_package(package, new_id) returns a deep independent copy with id replaced, status="draft", and approvals=[]. Preserve every other field; never mutate input.

tasks.title: Stable dependency ordering
tasks.contract: schedule(tasks) returns task ids in topological order. Each task has id and deps. Repeatedly choose the first currently eligible task in original input order (restart the scan after each choice). Missing dependencies, duplicate ids, or cycles raise ValueError. Do not mutate input.

tasks.title: Quoted material CSV
tasks.contract: parse_csv(text) reads header-based CSV columns sku and quantity, returns list of {sku:str, quantity:int}. Support quoted commas, CRLF and reordered headers. Strip surrounding sku whitespace. Skip blank rows; reject empty sku or nonpositive quantity with ValueError.

tasks.title: Millimetres to cut length
tasks.contract: inches(mm) converts a nonnegative decimal string in mm to inches at exactly four decimal places with ROUND_HALF_UP. Use exact divisor 25.4. Negative values raise ValueError.

tasks.title: Atomic material reservation
tasks.contract: reserve(stock, requests) validates all requests then subtracts quantities from stock IN PLACE. Each request is {sku,qty}; qty must be positive, duplicate sku requests accumulate. Missing sku or insufficient quantity raises ValueError and leaves stock unchanged. Return stock.

tasks.title: UTC overdue checks
tasks.contract: overdue(due, now) parses ISO8601 timestamps (Z or explicit offset); naive timestamps are interpreted as UTC. Return true only when now is strictly later than due. Invalid strings raise ValueError.

tasks.title: Bounded retry delay
tasks.contract: retry_delay(attempt, base, cap) returns min(cap, base*2**attempt) for nonnegative integer attempt and nonnegative base/cap. Negative arguments raise ValueError. It must handle a billionth attempt promptly without constructing huge integers. base=0 returns zero.

tasks.title: Scoped idempotency keys
tasks.contract: key(tenant, operation, request_id) returns compact JSON encoding of the three strings in that order (ensure_ascii=False). It must be unambiguous even when fields contain colons or Unicode, and distinguish different tenants/operations.

tasks.title: Tie-safe pagination
tasks.contract: page(rows, after, limit) sorts by (created,id) ascending, filters strictly after the optional (created,id) cursor, and returns at most limit rows. limit <=0 raises ValueError. Preserve input order/data. created values are integers; ids strings.

tasks.title: Numeric revision sorting
tasks.contract: sort_revisions(values) sorts dot-separated nonnegative integer revision strings numerically. Missing trailing components compare as zero (1 == 1.0); equivalent revisions retain original order. Preserve original strings. Invalid components raise ValueError.

tasks.title: Partial receiving status
tasks.contract: receiving_status(expected, receipts) sums nonnegative receipt quantities. Reject expected<=0, negative quantities, or total>expected with ValueError. Return pending if zero received, complete if exactly expected, otherwise partial.

tasks.title: Latest QA decision
tasks.contract: qa_passed(records, revision) selects records for the exact revision, chooses largest sequence, and returns its passed bool. Equal sequence ties use last input record. No matching record is false; ignore decisions for other revisions.

tasks.title: Required station completion
tasks.contract: complete(required, events) returns true only if required is nonempty and every required station's last event has status done. Later reopened/failed events override done. Unknown stations do not affect the result. Events contain station and status.

tasks.title: Import validation errors
tasks.contract: validate(rows) returns ALL errors as {row:1-based index,field:sku or qty,message:required or positive integer}. sku must be nonempty after stripping. qty must have exact type int (bool is invalid) and be >0. Order errors by input row then sku before qty. Do not mutate rows.

tasks.title: Cached-token accounting
tasks.contract: cost(usage) returns API-equivalent dollars using input_tokens (INCLUDES cached_input_tokens), cached_input_tokens, output_tokens. Rates per million: 0.75 uncached, 0.075 cached, 4.5 output. Missing fields mean zero. Reject negative counts or cached>input with ValueError; never count cached input twice.
